paragraphs.text:
BOSTON RAILWAY ST ATION
There are two trains to New York City’s Grand Central Station. 
One leaves at 10am and arrives at 5pm; the other leaves at 4pm 
and arrives at 10pm. Go to 146 upon arrival in New York City.
Trains depart for Arkham at 10am, 1pm, and 6pm, and arrive 
one hour later. Go to 16 upon arrival in Arkham.
Should you miss the train, you have friends in Boston who 
gladly will pick you up and put you up for the night for free. You 
can then catch your train in the morning (see above).
(Boston Location)
